purpose: Publication-oriented status summary of frozen synthetic PCC Poker claims. Human-data claims are intentionally excluded.

status_definitions.confirmed: All direct preregistered acceptance criteria represented by the source artifact passed.
status_definitions.partial: The primary confirmation failed, but one or more prespecified component checks passed.
status_definitions.failed: The represented claim failed its direct acceptance criterion without qualifying component support sufficient for partial status.
status_definitions.unresolved: No conservative cross-family observable is currently selected for this claim/axis.

claims.claim: Frozen engineered PCC policies exhibit the prespecified balanced Pressure→Chaos→Control→Pressure cycle.
The frozen PCC cycle is robust across the prespecified temperature, purity, and match-length grid.
Contextually aligned Control specifically improves performance against Pressure under matched counterfactual controls.
Generic model-alignment counterfactuals identify a Control-specific dependence across targets.
Public temporal-history prediction gain is a discriminant observational measure of Control.
claims.evidence: passed 2/4 prespecified checks; failed: control_correlation_at_least_0_20, control_correlation_discriminant

claims.claim: Matched public-history likelihood contrast is a family-invariant observational measure of Control.
claims.evidence: cross_family_control_gap=0.602; passed 2/3 prespecified checks; failed: cross_family_control_gap_at_most_0_20

claims.claim: Value-floor-weighted effective surprisal is a cross-family discriminant observational measure of Chaos.
Conditioning on public history universally separates Control-linked surprise from Chaos-linked residual surprise.
Public Pressure exposure universally explains the negative Pressure/effective-surprisal association and improves Chaos discrimination.
At least one conservative label-free Pressure observable is stable across both policy families.
A conservative label-free Control observable is currently supported across both policy families.
A conservative label-free Chaos observable is currently supported across both policy families.
Supervised PCC coordinate recovery transfers invariantly between the Score and Independent policy families.
claims.evidence: Current supervised PCC coordinates are not implementation-invariant.

claims.claim: Continuous synthetic PCC mixture weights are identifiable above the prespecified baselines within the development family.
claims.scope: synthetic mixture recovery; not human construct validity

claims.claim: The frozen synthetic validation bundle is complete and reproducibility-audit ready.
